_comment: Section 7. One roll a cycle, two after cycle 20, weighted by the highest sector unlocked. Weights are percentages and are normalised over whatever is eligible, so a Signal that cannot land without a Sensor Array simply redistributes.

notes.fire: Destroys a module on its stack at cycle end if no crew is working it.
notes.breach: Costs 4 oxygen every cycle it is left open.
notes.contamination: Infects a crew card it shares a stack with.
notes.stowaway: Leaves after two cycles if not recruited.
notes.drone: Injures a crew card on its stack each cycle.
notes.signal: Fades after three cycles. Only appears once a Sensor Array is listening.
